items.q: How to become an artist on Atelier Blanc?
items.a: You can upload artworks after registering an account. We welcome artists of all mediums, including oil paintings, digital art, photography, etc. Artworks are listed instantly upon upload without waiting for manual review.

items.q: Can I be both a buyer and a seller?
items.a: Yes. The same account can upload your own artworks, as well as purchase or rent artworks from other artists.
Currently, the platform is in Beta testing, and all payment flows (including credit cards, ECPay, PayPal, and Web3 crypto) are in Sandbox test mode. No real transactions or deductions are processed.
Since this is currently a testing phase, please do not enter any real credit card numbers or sensitive information.

items.q: Can I get a refund after purchasing?
items.a: Physical artworks have a 7-day appreciation period upon receipt. If there is shipping damage or it does not match the description within this period, you can contact the platform and the artist for a refund. Digital artworks cannot be retracted after download and are non-refundable once sold.

items.q: When do artists receive their sales proceeds?
items.a: Once the buyer receives the physical artwork and the 7-day appreciation period passes without dispute, the order is automatically marked as 'Completed'. The platform will then automatically transfer the funds (minus fees) to the artist's configured PayPal account or crypto wallet.

items.q: Does the platform charge transaction fees?
items.a: During the current promotional period, transaction fees are charged according to the rules of each payment provider (such as Stripe, ECPay, PayPal, or blockchain networks). The platform does not take additional commission at this time.

items.q: How to download a digital artwork after purchase?
items.a: After successful payment, you can directly click 'Download High-Res Original' on the checkout success page, or go to 'My Collection' in your personal dashboard to download it again. The download link is valid for 15 minutes each time and can be regenerated unlimited times.

items.q: Are digital artworks protected by copyright?
items.a: All digital artworks retain the author's copyright. Purchase grants authorization limited to personal enjoyment and non-commercial display. Unauthorized commercial use, resale, or widespread distribution constitutes infringement.
Yes. Images generated by the AI model used on this platform belong to the Public Domain or permit commercial use. Artworks you generate through the platform's AI Studio can be freely listed for sale.

items.q: What is the process for renting an artwork?
items.a: After selecting a rental plan and completing the payment, the platform holds your deposit. Once the physical artwork is delivered and confirmed undamaged (3-7 day confirmation period), the rental agreement officially begins, and the platform will release the first month's rent to the artist.

items.q: When will the rental deposit be refunded?
items.a: After the rental period expires and the artwork is returned to the artist completely undamaged, the platform will refund the held deposit to your credit card or Web3 wallet through the system backend. If paid in fiat, the deposit is held in the platform's PayPal balance; if paid in crypto, the deposit is securely locked in a smart contract.

items.q: Does the platform provide shipping services?
items.a: Currently, the platform does not provide official shipping services. Details such as shipping methods, freight costs, and international delivery for physical artworks need to be discussed and arranged directly between the buyer and the artist (seller).

Shipping.title: Shipping & Return Policy
Shipping.subtitle: Atelier Blanc is an art trading platform. Shipping and returns of physical artworks are to be negotiated and handled directly by the buyer and seller.
Shipping.physicalDeliveryContent1: Currently, the platform does not provide official shipping services or transport insurance. The packaging, shipping cost calculation, and delivery method of physical artworks should be discussed and arranged directly between the buyer and the artist (seller) via the platform's messaging feature.
Shipping.physicalDeliveryContent2: It is recommended that both parties clearly agree on the following before the transaction:

Shipping.digitalDeliveryContent1: After payment is complete, you can immediately download the high-resolution original file (PNG / TIFF) on the 'My Collection' page.
Shipping.digitalDeliveryContent2Pre: The download link is valid for

Shipping.digitalDeliveryContent3: Digital artworks come with an authorization certificate detailing the scope of personal use and copyright ownership.
Shipping.rentalDeliveryContent1: The shipping and return of rented physical artworks are also negotiated directly by both parties. Please confirm the logistics arrangements for the return with the other party in advance before the lease expires.
Shipping.rentalDeliveryContent2: The platform recommends that both parties take photos and videos as evidence when sending and receiving artworks to protect their respective rights.
Shipping.returnPolicyPhysicalContent: : Return and exchange rules (including non-damage returns and handling of damaged goods) are set by the seller. Buyers must confirm the return policy with the artist before placing an order. If the artwork arrives damaged, please take photos immediately and contact the artist.
Shipping.returnPolicyDigitalContent: : Due to the nature of digital goods, refunds and exchanges are not accepted after download.
Shipping.returnPolicyDepositContent: : Once the artwork is returned to the artist completely undamaged and verified by the artist, the deposit will be refunded to the original payment method.
Shipping.insuranceContent: Since the platform acts as an intermediary, we strongly recommend that buyers and sellers purchase full transport insurance via a third-party logistics company when shipping high-value artworks to avoid disputes over damage during transit.
